author: pgaudet
body:
- GO:1990042 glycerol dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity and 
- GO:0004486 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity 

are grouping terms for the NAD and NADP-specific activities. We will make these terms 'do not annotate', see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30105

Please fix annotations: 
- [S000005646](https://www.yeastgenome.org/search?q=S000005646&is_quick=true): from [glycerol dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:1990042) to 
GO:0047953 glycerol 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
- P11586: one BHF, on Reacome, one PINC (fixed): move from GO:0004486 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity to GO:0004488 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
(this one is strange, there are annotations to both NAD and NADP-specific forms, is this an error?) 



Thanks, Pascale
title: NAD/NADP: More specific annotations requested

author: pgaudet
source_title: Tweaks to MF terms with 'NAD(P)' activity

author: deustp01
body: Reactome instance of GO:0004486 corrected to GO:0004488. The annotated reaction shows use of NADP+ and NADPH so the NAD(P) activity term was a mistake.

author: sjm41
body:
Hi @RLovering 
Looks like you changed the BHF annotation on P11586 to 'glycerol 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity' -that suggestion was for the yeast [S000005646](https://www.yeastgenome.org/search?q=S000005646&is_quick=true).

Can you change the BHF annotation on P11586 to GO:0004488 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity? (the assay used NADP rather than NAD)

Thanks.

author: sjm41
body:
Actually, it looks like you changed the BHF **ISS** annotation on P11586 to 'glycerol 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity' - that ISS annotation (which was originally to 'methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity') should just be deleted, given there are good EXP annotations for P11586

(the source annotation for that ISS is Q922D8 (mouse Mthfd1) from PMID:23704330 - that paper doesn't specify NAD/NADP, but the paper they point to in the methods for the assay (PMID:18767138) says they used NADP. So you should change the Q922D8 annotation to use methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity (GO:0004488).)

Then, the BHF **IDA** annotation on P11586 to 'methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity' from PMID:1881876 should be changed to GO:0004488 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity? (the assay specifically used NADP), and then that also fits with the EC annotation the UniProt curated from the same paper.

Thanks!

body:
